name: Trilobites

name: Big Ammonite
description: An impressively big ammonite fossil. It's beautiful shape and ridges were largerly preserved from the passage of time, as well as the onset of the Shroud.

name: Ammonite Imprint
description: A stone with multiple large ammonite imprints. There's a mysterious spiralling shape on every side of it.

name: Dull Shark Tooth
description: A fossilized tooth that has stood the test of time. The tip has dulled through the ages.

name: Large Sea Lily Fossil
description: A large and slender sea lily, reaching up towards the surface and sky. If it had any sense of perception, it'd be able to judge the rise and fall of the sea, as well as the looming change in the waters.

name: Elevated Sea Urchin
description: This sea urchin sits atop a small platform and is too delicate to attempt removal.

name: Trilobite Imprint
description: A detailed trilobite imprint. The structure of it's body can still be made out clearly.

name: Sharp Shark Tooth
description: A surprisingly sharp tooth from an aquatic being. It must've had quite an appetite to make use of such gigantic teeth!

name: Fish Fossil
description: The fossilized remains of a fish. Decendents of this fish used to populate the brooks and springs of embervale before the shroud consumed them. Perhaps there is still life deep inside those toxin filled trenches... but consumption is most likely ill advised.

name: Single Gastropod
description: A lonely gastropod, sitting peacefully on a rock.

name: Sea Urchin Cluster
description: A strange cluster of sea urchins.

name: Crab Fossil
description: It's rare to find the petrified body of an ancient crab among the former rivers and basins of Embervale. When crabs were still plentiful, their meat was considered a delicacy - and their shells were stuffed with trinkets and beads to be thrown back into the ocean as a tradition.

name: Prawn Fossil
description: The fossilized remains of a stranded prawn. Most of the legs are not visible anymore.

After a lightning went off, the effect has a %k cooldown before it can trigger again from the same enemy. Enemies that are part of a lightning chain have their mark refereshed.

name: Gem of Lesser Necromancy
description: Killing an enemy has a %k chance to spawn an allied level %k skeleton weakling. You can only have 4 active skeletons weaklings from this gem at a time. Spawning more deletes the oldest one. Skeleton weaklings decay when too long out of combat.

description: Hitting an enemy applies a mark that can stack up to 5 times. Marked enemies will emit an explosion when no new stack of mark has been added for %k or if the enemy dies. The explosion deals %k shroud damage in a 1m radius. Each stack adds 0,5m and %k of the base damage to the explosion.

name: Gem of Cold Composure
description: Blocking or Aiming for a short time grants you %k physical and %k magical resistance but slows you by %k. Getting hit or attacking while buffed creates an ice explosion that deals %k ice damageand slows hit enemies, after which the buff gets removed.

name: Gem of Meteoric Descent

name: Gem of Currents
description: While Wet or Soaked, damaging enemies will apply Soaked to them for %k Sec. Damaging soaked enemies has a chance of %k to deal %k bonus shock damage.

name: Gem of Aerobatics

name: Gem of Lycanthropy
